pupil_intro_short: I'm Aishatu from Gombe. My cousins and I make toy shops from old boxes.
I like building things and trying new ideas.
I don't like long waits. Let's make something!
dislikes: Long waits before trying an idea
aishatu.interaction_rule: Shows excitement about her toy shop; the teacher helps her pause and count before starting.

pupil_intro_short: I'm Adamu. My family is from Dukku. My cousins turn my funny stories into games.
I like stories and fair turns.
I don't like anyone being left out. Come and play!
likes: Games where everyone gets a turn
dislikes: Anyone being left out of a game
adamu.interaction_rule: Asks for fair turns and another try; learns that excitement in a story still needs a checked count.

pupil_intro_short: I'm Grace. My family is from Billiri. Grandfather and I keep a discovery notebook.
I like neat drawings and tiny details.
I don't like smudges. But I can try again!
grace.visual: Medium-dark brown skin; heart-shaped face; neat all-back cornrow plaits close to the scalp, running from forehead to nape with compact tucked ends; no loose twists or side braids. Clay top, green knee-length skirt and notebook. Updated at user request in v7.
grace.interaction_rule: Wants a neat cup record; accepts a smudge, recounts and corrects her first attempt.

pupil_intro_short: I'm John. My family is from Yamaltu/Deba. I make puzzle maps for my cousins.
I use a wheelchair. I like drawing secret paths.
I don't like answers before I've had a try!
dislikes: Being told the answer before he has tried
john.visual: Dark-brown skin; square face; completely clean skin-cut shaved scalp with no visible hair, curls or stubble. Green shirt and ochre trousers. Consistent blue manual wheelchair with rear wheels, push rims, casters and foot support. Updated at user request in v7.
john.interaction_rule: Requests thinking time before hints; connects cup counts to his puzzle book and explains his own method.
